title: Refine Workorder Schema
description: Refine `schemas/workorder.schema.json` to include token projection fields and strict definitions for dependencies. This schema is the absolute contract for the WDD relay.

requirements.token_projection: Add `token_projection` (integer, optional) to estimate execution cost.
requirements.dependencies: Promote `dependencies` (array of strings) to a required property.

acceptance_criteria: The schema passes JSON draft-07 validation.
failure_modes: FAIL: Adding fields that break backward compatibility without a version bump.
